## Change

## Visual evidence

Include a screenshot or short video of the implemented behavior here. Show the
interaction and result, and identify the platform and source commit. Include
both macOS and Windows when both are affected. Label automated native fixtures.
For internal changes, show the measured or validation result; for documentation,
show the rendered content. See [the evidence rule](https://github.com/jmpijll/slightshot/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#visual-review-evidence).
